summary: Verified 3 bug fixes: (1) System admin sees ALL sites via /api/main-sites/my/access (11/12 backend tests passed - 92%), (2) Network admin (non-system) code now queries ONLY main_site_users for direct access (code review verified), (3) ZeroTier send-daily-summary passes main_site_id to filter specific site (code review verified). CLI Save Wizard code review confirms auto-close after ~5 seconds.

minor.issue: Transient connection reset error during test (network issue, not code bug)

issues: DialogContent accessibility warnings - missing DialogTitle for screen readers (console warnings, not blocking)

critical_code_review_comments: main_sites.py get_my_main_site_access (line ~717): System admin path fetches ALL sites from db.main_sites.find({}), network admin (non-system) path fetches ONLY from db.main_site_users where user_id matches - CORRECT FIX
zerotier.py trigger_daily_summary (line ~445): Now passes main_site_id to _send_daily_summary(db, main_site_id=main_site_id) - CORRECT FIX
zerotier_alerts.py _send_daily_summary (line ~259): Accepts optional main_site_id param and adds query['main_site_id'] = main_site_id filter - CORRECT FIX
CLISaveWizard.js: Uses useRef for stable onClose reference, timers set in single useEffect with cleanup, total duration ~5 seconds (1800+2000+1200ms) - CORRECT FIX

success_rate.frontend: Code review only - CLI only available in MainSiteDashboard, not NetworkDashboard

context_for_next_testing_agent: Three bugs verified fixed: (1) /api/main-sites/my/access now correctly splits system_admin (sees ALL sites) vs network_admin non-system (sees ONLY direct main_site_users access). (2) ZeroTier send-daily-summary endpoint passes main_site_id to _send_daily_summary function which filters the query. (3) CLISaveWizard uses ref-based approach with proper timer cleanup and auto-closes after ~5 seconds. Note: CLI button only appears in MainSiteDashboard (when viewing a specific site), not in NetworkDashboard.
